
# NextCV

> NextCV is an online resume builder for Indian freshers and job seekers, offering ATS-oriented resume templates, AI-assisted resume writing, and career tools.

NextCV helps users create, edit, and preview resumes online before purchasing a watermark-free PDF download. Its pricing model uses one-time payments rather than recurring subscriptions.

## Main Website

- [NextCV Homepage](https://nextcv.in/): Official website and resume-building product.

## Product Features

- [Resume Builder](https://nextcv.in/): Create and edit a resume using available templates and resume-building tools.
- [Resume Builder Comparisons](https://nextcv.in/resume-builder-comparison): Compare resume-building services and alternatives.
- [Public Resume Sharing](https://nextcv.in/): Resume sharing links are available with eligible plans.

## Pricing

- [NextCV](https://nextcv.in/): Check the live website for current plans, prices, and included features.

## Important Information

- Resume templates are designed to support ATS readability; actual parsing and hiring outcomes depend on the resume, employer, and recruitment system.
- AI-generated content should be reviewed and corrected by the user before applying for jobs.
- Product features, prices, and policies may change. Refer to the official website for current information.
